name: Nantong Zhenkang Welding Electromachinery Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 南通振康焊接机电有限公司
summary: Nantong Zhenkang manufactures precision RV reducers, welding wire-feed mechanisms and related automation components. Its RV reducer portfolio serves industrial robot transmission applications. The company is based in Haimen District, Nantong.
